name: com.atommerce.maca_android_sdk.ui.view.web.view.CommonWebViewActivity
description: When another Mindcafe feature opens a web page, this screen displays the configured page inside the app. The SDK uses it for counselor pages, legal documents, and other counseling service pages.
disableEffect: Users cannot open the counselor, legal, or other service pages that the Mindcafe SDK displays inside the app.
